headword: {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}

definitions.explanation: A period of leave from work granted to employees for the purpose of raising a child, legally guaranteed in Japan.

examples.japanese: {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The rate of men taking childcare leave is increasing.

examples.japanese: {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}{中|ちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{給付|きゅうふ}{金|きん}→給付金：20806_kyuufukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During childcare leave, benefits are paid from employment insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出産|しゅっさん}→出産：11734_shussan⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、{育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}して→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{専念|せんねん}した→専念する：25369_sennensuru⟧。
examples.english: After giving birth, she took childcare leave and devoted herself to raising her child.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧ (childcare) and ⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧ (leave from work). Often abbreviated to ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧ in everyday conversation.

Japan's Childcare and Family Care Leave Act (⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧・⟦{介護|かいご}{休業|きゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧) guarantees employees the right to take leave until their child turns one year old, with extensions possible up to two years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take childcare leave
- {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: childcare leave uptake rate
- {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}{給付|きゅうふ}{金|きん}: childcare leave benefits
- {育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}{中|ちゅう}: during childcare leave
- ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧{育児|いくじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}: paternity leave

CULTURAL NOTE:
While Japan has had generous childcare leave provisions on paper for decades, actual uptake by fathers has historically been very low. Government campaigns to encourage male ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧ have gained momentum in recent years, and the rate has been rising steadily.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧: childcare leave (abbreviation) — the casual, everyday form
- ⟦{産休|さんきゅう}→産休：06997_sankyuu⟧: maternity leave — specifically the period around childbirth
- ⟦{介護|かいご}{休業|きゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧: family care leave — leave for caring for elderly or ill family members
